name: bassoon
description: Jewelbox 44 Bassoon: big orange-red flamed-maple bassoon on its side - the wing joint is the striker; behind it the parallel bass joint runs further left to the bell with an IVORY ring, joined at the right by the black-capped boot (U-bend); silver keys and an S-curved silver bocal with reed.
